1. (3 + 7) + 22 - 2 = 10 + 22 - 2 = 32 - 2 = 30 (too high)
2. 3 + 7 + 22 - 2 = 3 + 7 + 22 - 2 = 32 - 2 = 30 (too high)
3. 3 + 7 - 22 + 2 = 10 - 22 + 2 = -12 + 2 = -10 (too low)
4. 3 + 22 - 7 + 2 = 25 - 7 + 2 = 18 + 2 = 20 (too low)

7. 22 - 3 - 7 + 2 = 19 - 7 + 2 = 12 + 2 = 14 (this works!)

So, the final expression is:
<answer>22 - 3 - 7 + 2</answer>
